mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.25%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.25%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5% and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5.0%, the market anticipates further rate hikes due to labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5% AND FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (defined by UNRATE < 4.5% and CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 2.0%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5% AND CPIAUCSL (yoy) > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market tightness and impending monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5%, the market anticipates monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1800, the market anticipates a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 1800, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the strong demand expansion regime (defined by GDP growth above 16000 billion and residential fixed investment above 350000 million), the market anticipates sustained economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 16000 AND RSAFS > 350000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
